expectation: Membrane ring and dendrite-like processes on dendritic cells and some macrophages; sparse to moderate in number; scattered single cells in stroma or mucosa, denser as networks in lymphoid aggregates or T-cell zones; mostly HLA-DR+.
observed: A: diffuse yellow over tissue, debris specks off tissue. B/C: stromal haze plus a few bright elongated cells. D: bright elongated membrane-like profiles. E1: many discrete branched, dendritic-shaped cells forming a network; E3: some sit on HLADRA-bright areas, others green-only.
why: Row E shows a distinct population of branched, dendritic-morphology cells forming a network that partly overlaps HLADRA, well above the stromal haze.
notes: Whole-tissue and B/C views carry diffuse stromal haze and some off-tissue debris. In E, CD11c marks discrete branched cells with dendritic morphology arranged as a network, partly co-localised with HLADRA. That is a specific DC/macrophage population.
